name: 検索回答の参照資料を番号で追う一覧
prompt:
Create a single tall mobile “references” sheet on a white canvas, close to 1080:2358 (0.458:1 portrait). The original reference crop controls the full-height article-source list, top controls, divider, heading, numbered rows, and tight mobile column. The Japanese preview controls the exact localized copy, white presentation, teal-green links, typography, row spacing, and visible six-item state. Ignore the source article text behind the sheet and do not add status bars or a footer.

At the top, place a thin black X close icon at the left and a thin right-pointing arrow at the right, evenly inset. Draw a very light gray horizontal rule below the controls. Then a bold dark heading “参照資料”.

Show exactly six numbered citation rows beneath it in a single vertical column. Use small gray numbers at the left, teal-green Japanese title links, and dark charcoal summaries underneath, indented slightly beneath each title. Preserve compact but comfortable row spacing, clear hierarchy, and the preview’s thin Japanese sans-serif look. Keep all copy crisp and readable at mobile width.

1. Title “脳に必要な糖の役割”. Summary “— 脳がエネルギーを利用する仕組みを扱う資料の概要…”
2. Title “脳の糖代謝と機能”. Summary “— 代謝と脳の働きを一緒に調べるための文献…”
3. Title “農業と食料の見通し”. Summary “— 世界の食料について、今後の見通しを扱う資料…”
4. Title “世界の消費動向”. Summary “— 消費の変化について出典で確認するための資料…”
5. Title “甘いものを求める理由”. Summary “— 人の行動を進化の観点から説明する資料の概要…”
6. Title “甘さの感じ方と進化”. Summary “— 甘さへの反応をさまざまな観点から読む資料…”

Respect the Japanese preview’s restrained near-black text, muted teal-green link color, generous white background, left alignment, and natural line wrapping. Keep each number, title, and summary in its own legible row; the last item may end with the preview’s ellipsis.

Do not add source thumbnails, logos, extra citations, a search field, article title, paragraph above the list, dark overlays, shadows, cards, page footer, or watermark. Do not truncate or alter the supplied Japanese copy.
reviewNotes: Japanese numbered references list; visually reviewed for six entries, copy fidelity, hierarchy and clipping.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
